purpose: Teach: 見せつけ/混じり/ふやす/腰掛け/役立た/焼か/溶かし/襲い

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家族愛を見せつけるみたいに食事を作って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad made this meal like he's putting his family love on display.
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused observation. Soft, almost conspiratorial tone. Gentle fondness underlying the gentle teasing. Paced like she's sharing a small, private joy with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんと話す時、ぼくは笑顔混じりに聞いてるよ
lines.en: Mom, when I talk to Dad, I'm smiling the whole time.
lines.style: Quiet certainty with a small smile underneath. No self-consciousness. Matter-of-fact delivery of something deeply true. Slow, genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達をふやす努力をしてみてね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you try making a few more friends?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not pressure. Warm but practical — a mother's quiet nudge. Even pace, open-ended. No judgment in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが縁側に腰掛けてお茶を召し上がってるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's sitting on the veranda having tea.
lines.style: Small, observant report. Quietly pleased by the image. Tender noticing. Pause-weight on the scene itself — he's painting it for her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは家族のためなら役立たない事は無いって仰るわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says there's nothing he wouldn't do for the family.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the statement. Reflective, not boastful. Speaking his father's values with her own belief in them. Steady, measured.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがパンを焼かれる匂いが好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really love the smell of Dad baking bread.
lines.style: Eager but genuine, not performative. The small sensory joy breaks through with real feeling. Bright but not loud — innocent delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがチョコを溶かしてケーキを作って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad melted chocolate and made us a cake.
lines.style: Pleased, almost wonder-struck at the care. Warmth in the delivery. Speaking it like a small gift has just arrived. Gentle gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、雷雨が襲い来ても、ぼくはお父さんと一緒なら平気だよ
lines.en: Mom, even if a thunderstorm came, I'd be okay as long as I'm with Dad.
lines.style: Earnest, unguarded. The vulnerability of complete trust. Slow, sincere. No hesitation — just absolute certainty in his voice. Closes the exchange with tenderness.
